messages:
Elena: hi all, first week! quick q: I created an Okta group for our team so they can flip staging feature flags. How does that group become an FF owner in Console?
Raj: welcome! short flow: people-ops creates the Okta group, infra adds it to the flag_permissions config, then the sync job picks it up.
Elena: who owns the infra PR? I couldn't find the repo in the handbook.
Grace: infra-maintainers own that repo (infra/console-perms). Open a PR adding the group to the specific flag entry. Tag @infra and @people-ops for a quick merge.
Elena: is there a template for the PR body? want to include the right approvals and rollback text.
Grace: use the PR template: include flag name, reasoning, desired expiry (if temporary), monitoring checklist, and rollback criteria. Example line: "Rollback if error-rate > 0.5% within 30m".
people-ops: FYI people-ops will verify group membership before we merge. please include the Okta group ID in the PR.
Elena: ok thanks — where do I find the Okta group id?
Raj: Okta UI -> Groups -> click group -> copy the ID from the URL (it starts with 00g...). or use the API: `curl -H "Authorization: SSWS $OKTA_TOKEN" https://okta.internal/api/v1/groups?q=our-team`
Elena: awesome, filing PR now. tagging @grace for review.
ops-bot: PR #789 created by Elena in infra/console-perms. Status: awaiting review :hourglass:
